answer: An agent economy admits each new identity only behind a 500-POA sponsor bond, every endorsement carved as a signed edge into one public canyon of lineage. When settlement proves a single clone forged, the slash cascades down the whole subtree: every account beneath that sponsor forfeits its full bond. A farm of N linked aliases therefore freezes N real stakes in parallel across the audit horizon, and the comforting fable that a thousand cheap clones shelter under one backer collapses, since each must post, and lose, its own capital.
